title: Ameed Coffee
description:
A concept we designed for Al Ameed Coffee to try a different kind of product page. Instead of a regular grid, you scroll through the products one at a time. Each pack slides in, the page takes on its colour, and you see the roast and whether it comes with cardamom. Built in Arabic and works on mobile.

This is our own concept and isn't affiliated with Al Ameed Coffee.
challenge: Show a range of eight similar packs without it turning into a boring grid.
solution: One product per screen: as you scroll, each pack slides in and the whole page changes to its colour, so every product gets its moment.

title: Kabseh (كبسة)
description: A single-page Arabic, right-to-left marketing website for Kabseh (كبسة), a food-delivery app in Amman, with ordering steps, offers, sign-up sections for restaurants and delivery captains, and FAQs.
overview: Kabseh (كبسة) is a food-delivery app in Amman, Jordan. VELIX designed and developed a single-page Arabic website for the app, covering food categories, how ordering works, why to choose the app, current offers, "join us" sections for restaurants and delivery captains, frequently asked questions and app download links.
solution: A right-to-left Arabic layout built as a single static page, with scroll-triggered and pointer-driven GSAP animation, optimized WebP imagery and a responsive design for desktop and mobile. The "join us" forms are not yet connected to a backend.
seoDescription: A single-page Arabic, right-to-left marketing website for Kabseh (كبسة), a food-delivery app in Amman, with ordering steps, offers, sign-up sections for restaurants and delivery captains, and FAQs.

title: Jaml (جمل)
description: An Arabic, right-to-left marketing website for Jaml (جمل), a Jordanian food-delivery app, presenting how ordering works, app features, partner-restaurant information and FAQs.
overview: Jaml (جمل) is a food-delivery app operating in Jordan. VELIX built a one-page Arabic website for the app that walks visitors through food categories, the ordering steps, the app's main features, a section for partner restaurants, frequently asked questions and contact details, with links to the app on the App Store and Google Play.
solution: A fully right-to-left Arabic layout with self-hosted Arabic web fonts, smooth scrolling and scroll-triggered animation, and a responsive design for desktop and mobile. The contact form opens the visitor's email app (mailto). The site is static, with no backend.
seoDescription: An Arabic, right-to-left marketing website for Jaml (جمل), a Jordanian food-delivery app, presenting how ordering works, app features, partner-restaurant information and FAQs.

title: South Axis
description: A bilingual Arabic/English website for South Axis (محور الجنوب), a structural-steel contracting company in Amman, built around a custom animated 3D steel-structure graphic.
overview: South Axis (محور الجنوب) is a contracting company in Amman, Jordan, working in modern steel buildings and structural steel. VELIX designed and developed the company's website: a single-page bilingual experience presenting the company, its services and its contact details.
solution: The site switches between Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) with an in-page language toggle. Its hero is a custom steel-structure animation drawn on HTML canvas with a hand-written 3D projection (no 3D library), paired with scroll-triggered GSAP animation and a scroll progress indicator. The layout is fully responsive for desktop and mobile.
seoDescription: A bilingual Arabic/English website for South Axis (محور الجنوب), a structural-steel contracting company in Amman, built around a custom animated 3D steel-structure graphic.
